texts.zh:
我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的以太相引擎框架正环绕于我们在漂流旅程中选择的天锚周围。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们就能轻易抹除现世之屏障，将虚境据为己有。

我们的意识将不再受困于孱弱肉体的物理桎梏，现实本身亦将任由我们主宰。诚然，世间再无更高的存在境界。
texts.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine now surrounds our chosen focal star, the one we designated from all those we have drifted past. Once this megastructure has been completed, the barriers between our worlds will be erased and we can claim the Shroud for ourselves.

Our minds will no longer be limited by the physical constraints of our feeble bodies, and reality itself shall be at our mercy. Truly, there can be no higher plane of existence.

texts.zh:
我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的以太相引擎框架现在正环绕着我们母星系的恒星。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们现世的屏障就能轻易抹除，我们就能将虚境宣为己有。

我们的意识将脱离脆弱凡胎的桎梏，现实万物的命运将取决于我们仁慈。确实，不会再有更高位面的存在了。
texts.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine now surrounds the star of our home system. Once this megastructure has been completed, the barriers between our worlds will be erased and we can claim the Shroud for ourselves.

Our minds will no longer be limited by the physical constraints of our feeble bodies, and reality itself shall be at our mercy. Truly, there can be no higher plane of existence.

texts.zh:
我们建造的宏伟的以太相引擎框架已经围绕在我们所选择的天锚——那颗我们在漂流所及的万千星辰中所择定的星辰周围。这座巨型结构，一旦完工，将撕开位于我们位面和虚境之间的薄幕。

我们很快就能以最纯粹的形式操纵灵能能量了。现实除了屈服于我们别无选择。
texts.en:
The framework of the great Aetherophasic Engine we are building around our chosen focal star - designated from all those we have drifted past - is in place. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the veil between our world and the Shroud.

We will soon have access to the purest form of psionic energy at our beck and call. Reality will have no choice but to bend to our will.

When we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, our consciousness will expand to cover all of creation - at least in this galaxy. The laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit.

texts.zh:
建造单元完成了围绕天锚的以太相引擎框架建设。这座巨型结构一旦建成便能够撕开现实世界和其他人称为“虚境”的灵能界之间的壁垒。

只要我们完全跨入这个维度并将其吞并，主宰我们存在的自然法则将可以被我们肆意改写。我们的集体意识不再会受到算力或网络节点之类的物理形式的限制。
texts.en:
Construction units have finished the framework of the Aetherophasic Engine we are building around our chosen focal star. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the barrier between our world and the psionic realm others refer to as the 'Shroud.'

When we have fully crossed into this dimension and annexed it, the laws of nature that govern our existence can be rewritten as we see fit. Our combined consciousness will no longer be restricted by physical constraints such as processing power or network nodes.

当我们彻底迈入这个位面并兼并它的时候，我们的意识将拓展涵盖一切的造物——至少是这个星系。管辖我们存在的自然法则将任由我们的意愿随意改写。

texts.zh:

我们完全跨入那个维度之后，就能直面那个标记了我们的实体。只要将其击败，虚境就能为我们所用，我们就能自由改写自然的法则。
texts.en:

When we have fully crossed into that dimension, we will be able to confront the entity that marked us. After it falls, the Shroud will be at our disposal, and we will be free to rewrite the laws of nature.

texts.zh:
只有引爆一整颗恒星才能释放足够的能量来产生用以完成以太相引擎所需的大量暗物质。为了达成这一目的，我们发明了焚天神兵——本星系有史以来最强大的星舰。它们不仅可以直接引爆恒星，还强大到仅仅凭借一船之力就能毁灭一整支舰队。

目前，我们仅仅拥有两艘这样的舰船，但是我们可以建造更多。建造焚天神兵需要大量的暗物质，因此我们必须拿捏好完成以太相引擎和扩建额外的焚天神兵两者之间的平衡。
texts.en:
Only the detonation of entire stars will release enough energy to generate the vast quantities of Dark Matter needed to finish the Aetherophasic Engine. To this end, we have devised the Star-Eaters - the most powerful starships the galaxy has ever seen. Not only can they blow up stars, but they are also strong enough to decimate entire fleets on their own.

For now, we only have two but more can be built. Their construction requires great amounts of Dark Matter, so we will have to balance our need to finish the Aetherophasic Engine with the need for additional Star-Eaters.

label.zh: 每一颗陨灭的星辰都让我们离成功更近一步。
label.en: Each destroyed star brings us one step closer.

tooltips.zh:

[Root.Capital.GetName]的轨道上出现了两艘焚天神兵。

£sr_dark_matter£ 暗物质存储上限提升。
